The stepped/sawtooth roof language is present, but the section feels arbitrary and too fragmented to convincingly support clear-span gym logic. The front edge also does not strongly resolve into a recognizable entry/public seam tied to the access frontage. Overall it has decent repair integrity and some precedent resonance, but fails the hard program-fit test because the hall typology is not legible enough.
